thread:
dina: Heads-up - vendor sent an embargoed note about an HSM attestation regression after a firmware push. Possible BYOK impact. Need quick triage for RBAC, audit extraction, and fallback.
mark: Is there a repro? DM please.
dina: Sent DM with minimal repro steps. Customer hit a failed attestation during a rotate.
lucy: Immediate ops steps: stop auto-updates on affected pools, switch audit level to verbose for Wrap/Sign/Attest, snapshot attestation blobs and export to secure vault.
mark: RBAC mitigation: list principals with both WrapKey and ExportKey, then apply short-lived deny for ExportKey and enable JIT for hsm-admins.
ops-bot: ALERT: unusual WrapKey rate on hsm-prod-apac. Incident created #6155000012 :rotating_light:
mark: Quick log query I'll run:
```
resource.type="hsm_key" protoPayload.methodName="WrapKey"
```
lucy: Also collect protoPayload.request.attestation fields. If chain is broken we should prepare rewrap playbook and notify Legal/Compliance for BYOK customers.
dina: Draft customer blurb: "We observed an HSM attestation anomaly after a vendor firmware update. We're investigating; no evidence of key extraction. We can offer a vetted rewrap and a full audit package. Contact support@redwood.com to opt in." feedback?
mark: Good. Add note to include operator-entitlement findings if vendor says exploit needs console access.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow BYOK incident runbook and escalate to PCI/PHI leads if affected keys protect regulated data.
dina: Actions: @mark run principal+wrap scan + upload artifacts; @lucy snapshot attestation blobs and prepare rewrap checklist; I'll coordinate vendor and Legal. Keep updates here.
